noticeDescription:
NOTICE OF APPLICATION(S)

(Under the Planning Act)

 

The City has received the following application under the Planning Act:

 

NORTH YORK COMMUNITY COUNCIL AREA:

 

Application Number: 26 257236 NNY 06 OZ and 26 257298 NNY 06 SB

A Zoning By-law Amendment with District Plan and Plan of Subdivision applications which propose a mixed-use community within the Arbo Phase 2 lands (1350 Sheppard Avenue West) of the Downsview Secondary Plan.  The proposal by Build Canada Homes (formerly Canada Lands Corporation) consists of buildings ranging from 6 to 35 storeys in height and providing approximately 3,160 residential units and 10,000 square metres of non-residential gross floor area, including retail, community space, a potential elementary school and a daycare. The proposal also includes a public parkland dedication of 1.54 hectares, 0.96 hectares of open space, and a network of public streets, pedestrian and cycling connections, and greenways.

1350 Sheppard Avenue West (Arbo Phase 2)

Ward 6 – York Centre

Perry Korouyenis, Planner, at 416-395-7110 or Perry.Korouyenis@toronto.ca. 

 

CONTACT INFORMATION 

 

City Clerk, Attention: Registrar Secretariat

Toronto City Hall, 2nd Floor West, 100 Queen Street West, Toronto, ON, M5H 2N2, 

Tel: 416-394-8101, Email: RegistrarCCO@toronto.ca.   

 

BACKGROUND INFORMATION

 

Background information and materials regarding the above-listed proposals are available at www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/application-information-centre/.   

 

FURTHER INFORMATION

 

If you wish to receive notice regarding the progression of any of the proposed applications above, which include Official Plan amendment, proposed Draft Plan of Subdivision, Draft Plan of Common Elements Condominium, Vacant Land Condominium Application and/or proposed Zoning By-law amendment, you may make a request to the City Clerk, to the attention of the Registrar Secretariat, at the address or email noted above.
